name: squeeze_floor_nan_rejected
description: AC-1 / M-2: a NaN squeeze_floor is rejected at entry with ValueError (reject-don't-coerce, same policy as the non-finite guard on the other float params). A NaN floor silently poisoning a max()/min() comparison could suppress the clamp. squeeze_floor is a string sentinel here ('nan') that the loader converts to float('nan').
derivation: squeeze_floor is NaN. _reject_non_finite(squeeze_floor=nan) raises ValueError at function entry, before any clamp arithmetic. No value is returned.
